description: Implement fixes to prevent stale prior-task answers: make minion delegation reminders non-user context without mandatory acknowledgement, gate hints on current prompt/tool count, raise/disable prompt length default, fix spawn_bg wording, stop OM suggested-response injection/stickiness, add recency guard for active guidance publication, and filter OM out of minion subsessions. Add regression tests and run lint/test/typecheck.
title: Harden minions delegation hints and OM active guidance
